scripts.script:
--[[
    Advanced Team ESP Script for Roblox
    Features:
    - Press P to toggle ESP
    - Green highlight for teammates
    - Red highlight for enemies
    - Health bars above characters
    - Bulletproof cleanup system
    - Game verification (Afghanistan only)
    - PC/Laptop only restriction
    - GUI notification with exit button
]]

-- Configuration
local ESP_ENABLED = false
local TEAM_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)     -- Green for team
local ENEMY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)    -- Red for enemies
local FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.5
local OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY = 1

-- Game Verification
local ALLOWED_PLACE_ID = 9679014784 -- Afghanistan game ID

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Verify game and device
local function verifyAccess()
    -- Check if it's the Afghanistan game
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    
    if placeId ~= ALLOWED_PLACE_ID then
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
        return false
    end
    
    -- Check if on PC/Laptop (not mobile/tablet)
    local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    
    -- Check if touch is enabled (mobile/tablet)
    if userInputService.TouchEnabled then
        -- Additional check: if it's a touch device AND has small screen, it's mobile
        local screenSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if screenSize.X <= 1200 then
            LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
            return false
        end
    end
    
    -- Check for mobile-specific features
    local isMobile = false
    
    -- Check platform type
    local platform = userInputService:GetPlatform()
    if platform == Enum.Platform.Android or platform == Enum.Platform.IOS then
        isMobile = true
    end
    
    -- Check for mobile-only UI
    if not isMobile and userInputService.GamepadEnabled then
        -- Could be a console or mobile with gamepad
        if userInputService.TouchEnabled then
            isMobile = true
        end
    end
    
    if isMobile then
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

-- Check if we have access
local hasAccess = verifyAccess()
if not hasAccess then
    return
end

-- Create notification GUI
local function createNotification()
    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name = "ESP_Notification"
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    
    -- Main frame
    local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 50)
    mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 20)
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
    mainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    mainFrame.ZIndex = 1000
    mainFrame.Parent = screenGui
    
    -- Add rounded corners effect
    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    uiCorner.Parent = mainFrame
    
    -- Text label
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Name = "NotificationText"
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = "Press (P) to enable ESP."
    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    textLabel.TextScaled = true
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    textLabel.ZIndex = 1001
    textLabel.Parent = mainFrame
    
    -- Exit button
    local exitButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    exitButton.Name = "ExitButton"
    exitButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
    exitButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 12)
    exitButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    exitButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    exitButton.Text = "X"
    exitButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    exitButton.TextScaled = true
    exitButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    exitButton.ZIndex = 1002
    exitButton.Parent = mainFrame
    
    -- Add rounded corners to exit button
    local exitCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    exitCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    exitCorner.Parent = exitButton
    
    -- Hover effect for exit button
    exitButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        exitButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    end)
    
    exitButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        exitButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    end)
    
    -- Exit button click function
    exitButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        -- Animate and destroy
        local tween = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        tween:Play()
        
        task.wait(0.3)
        screenGui:Destroy()
    end)
    
    -- Auto-hide after 10 seconds
    task.wait(10)
    if screenGui and screenGui.Parent then
        local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.7})
        fadeTween:Play()
        
        task.wait(0.5)
        screenGui:Destroy()
    end
    
    return screenGui
end

-- Create the notification
createNotification()

-- Storage for ESP instances
local espInstances = {}
local allConnections = {}

-- Function to completely clean up a player's ESP
local function cleanupESP(player)
    if not player then return end
    
    local espData = espInstances[player]
    if not espData then return end
    
    -- Disconnect all connections for this player
    if espData.connections then
        for _, conn in ipairs(espData.connections) do
            pcall(function()
                conn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        espData.connections = {}
    end
    
    -- Destroy highlight if it exists
    if espData.highlight then
        pcall(function()
            espData.highlight:Destroy()
        end)
        espData.highlight = nil
    end
    
    -- Destroy all GUI elements
    if espData.screenGui then
        pcall(function()
            espData.screenGui:Destroy()
        end)
        espData.screenGui = nil
    end
    
    -- Clear all other references
    espData.healthBar = nil
    espData.healthFill = nil
    espData.nameLabel = nil
    espData.character = nil
    espData.humanoid = nil
    
    -- Remove from table
    espInstances[player] = nil
end

-- Create health bar GUI
local function createHealthBar(player)
    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name = "ESP_HealthBar_" .. player.UserId
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    
    local healthBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    healthBar.Name = "HealthBar"
    healthBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 6)
    healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    healthBar.BorderSizePixel = 1
    healthBar.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    healthBar.Visible = false
    healthBar.ZIndex = 999
    healthBar.Parent = screenGui
    
    local healthFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    healthFill.Name = "HealthFill"
    healthFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    healthFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    healthFill.ZIndex = 1000
    healthFill.Parent = healthBar
    
    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 2)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.TextScaled = true
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.Text = player.Name
    nameLabel.ZIndex = 1001
    nameLabel.Parent = healthBar
    
    return screenGui, healthBar, healthFill, nameLabel
end

-- Get team color for a player
local function getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return TEAM_COLOR
    end
    
    -- Try to get team from various systems
    local team = player.Team
    if team then
        if player.Neutral then
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) -- Yellow for neutral
        end
        
        -- Compare team colors
        local localTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
        if localTeam and team == localTeam then
            return TEAM_COLOR
        else
            return ENEMY_COLOR
        end
    end
    
    -- Fallback: check for TeamService
    local teamService = game:GetService("Teams")
    local localTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
    if localTeam then
        for _, t in ipairs(teamService:GetTeams()) do
            if t == team then
                if t == localTeam then
                    return TEAM_COLOR
                else
                    return ENEMY_COLOR
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- If no team system, use player color
    return ENEMY_COLOR
end

-- Set up ESP for a player's character
local function setupCharacterESP(player, character)
    if not player or not character or not ESP_ENABLED then return end
    
    -- Clean up any existing ESP for this player first
    cleanupESP(player)
    
    -- Create Highlight
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
    highlight.FillTransparency = FILL_TRANSPARENCY
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY
    highlight.FillColor = getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    highlight.OutlineColor = getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    highlight.Parent = character
    
    -- Create health bar
    local screenGui, healthBar, healthFill, nameLabel = createHealthBar(player)
    
    -- Store instances
    local espData = {
        highlight = highlight,
        screenGui = screenGui,
        healthBar = healthBar,
        healthFill = healthFill,
        nameLabel = nameLabel,
        character = character,
        humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),
        connections = {}
    }
    
    espInstances[player] = espData
    
    -- Create update connection
    local updateConn
    updateConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not ESP_ENABLED then return end
        if not espInstances[player] then return end
        if not espData.character then return end
        if not espData.character.Parent then
            cleanupESP(player)
            return
        end
        
        local rootPart = espData.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = espData.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if rootPart and humanoid then
            local head = espData.character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local screenPos, onScreen = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                if onScreen then
                    espData.healthBar.Visible = true
                    espData.healthBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenPos.X - 25, 0, screenPos.Y)
                    
                    local healthPercent = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
                    espData.healthFill.Size = UDim2.new(healthPercent, 0, 1, 0)
                    
                    if healthPercent > 0.5 then
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                    elseif healthPercent > 0.25 then
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                    else
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    end
                    
                    espData.nameLabel.Text = player.Name
                else
                    espData.healthBar.Visible = false
                end
            else
                espData.healthBar.Visible = false
            end
        else
            espData.healthBar.Visible = false
        end
    end)
    
    table.insert(espData.connections, updateConn)
    
    -- Clean up when character dies
    if espData.humanoid then
        local diedConn = espData.humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.1)
            cleanupESP(player)
        end)
        table.insert(espData.connections, diedConn)
    end
    
    -- Clean up when character is removed
    local removedConn = character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if not character.Parent then
            task.wait(0.1)
            cleanupESP(player)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(espData.connections, removedConn)
end

-- Create ESP for a player
local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    
    -- Handle character added
    local charAddedConn
    charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.5) -- Wait for character to load
        if ESP_ENABLED then
            setupCharacterESP(player, character)
        end
    end)
    
    -- Store the character added connection
    if not allConnections[player] then
        allConnections[player] = {}
    end
    table.insert(allConnections[player], charAddedConn)
    
    -- Check if character already exists
    if player.Character then
        task.wait(0.1)
        if ESP_ENABLED then
            setupCharacterESP(player, player.Character)
        end
    end
end

-- Toggle ESP
local function toggleESP()
    ESP_ENABLED = not ESP_ENABLED
    
    if ESP_ENABLED then
        -- Enable ESP for all players
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                createESP(player)
            end
        end
    else
        -- Disable ESP for all players
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            cleanupESP(player)
        end
        
        -- Clear all stored connections
        for _, connections in pairs(allConnections) do
            for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
        end
        allConnections = {}
    end
    
    -- Print status
    print("ESP " .. (ESP_ENABLED and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED"))
end

-- Key bind
LocalPlayer:GetMouse().KeyDown:Connect(function(key)
    if key:lower() == "p" then
        toggleESP()
    end
end)

-- Connect player events
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    createESP(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    cleanupESP(player)
    
    -- Clean up all connections for this player
    if allConnections[player] then
        for _, conn in ipairs(allConnections[player]) do
            pcall(function()
                conn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        allConnections[player] = nil
    end
end)

-- Initial setup
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
        createESP(player)
    end
end

-- Status message
print("ESP Script loaded - Press P to toggle")
print("Game verified: Afghanistan")

local function IsVisible(Character, Head)
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = Head.Position - origin

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		LocalPlayer.Character
	}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

	if result then
		return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Character)
	end

	return false
end

local function GetClosestHead()
	local closestHead = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- Такой же центр, как у круга
	local screenCenter = Vector2.new(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then

			local Character = Player.Character
			local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local Humanoid =
				Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local position, onScreen =
					Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

				if onScreen then
					local screenPosition =
						Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)

					local distance =
						(screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude

					local insideFOV = true

					if FOVEnabled then
						insideFOV = distance <= FOV_RADIUS
					end

					if insideFOV then
						local canAim = true

						if WallCheckEnabled then
							canAim = IsVisible(Character, Head)
						end

						if canAim and distance < shortestDistance then
							shortestDistance = distance
							closestHead = Head
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestHead
end

end

noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.isNoclip = not _G.isNoclip
	if _G.isNoclip then
		noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: ON"
		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
		if not _G.isFlying then
			_G.isFlying = true
			toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
			toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
			startFlying()
		end
	else
		noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: OFF"
		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	end
end)

-- Mobile Hold Triggers (UP Button)
upBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		_G.verticalDirection = 1
	end
end)
upBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _G.verticalDirection == 1 then _G.verticalDirection = 0 end
	end
end)

-- Mobile Hold Triggers (DOWN Button)
downBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		_G.verticalDirection = -1
	end
end)
downBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _G.verticalDirection == -1 then _G.verticalDirection = 0 end
	end
end)

-- Dynamic Slider Drag Calculations
local function updateSpeed(input)
	local relativeX = input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
	local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
	sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
	_G.flySpeed = math.round(percentage * _G.maxSpeed)
	if _G.flySpeed < 5 then _G.flySpeed = 5 end
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. _G.flySpeed
end

local isDragging = false
sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isDragging = true
		updateSpeed(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		updateSpeed(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isDragging = false
	end
end)

-- UI Window State Handlers (Updated icons for Tween states)
local isMinimized = false
minimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	if isMinimized then
		mainWindow:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 35), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
		minimizeBtn.Text = "▢"
	else
		mainWindow:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 290), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
		minimizeBtn.Text = "▬"
	end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.isNoclip = false
	stopFlying()
	screenGui:Destroy()
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	_G.isNoclip = false
	stopFlying()
end)

scripts.script:
--[[
	Project: StepixHub v4.0 - Universal Mega Edition (99+ Games)
	Author: Stepix | Status: KEYLESS & SECURE
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or CoreGui

-- Cleanup old GUI
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("StepixHub_UniversalV4") then
    PlayerGui.StepixHub_UniversalV4:Destroy()
end

-- Main ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "StepixHub_UniversalV4"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

-- Main Frame (Luxurious UI)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 580, 0, 440)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -290, 0.5, -220)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 18)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 240)
MainStroke.Thickness = 2
MainStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Title Bar
local TitleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TitleBar.Parent = MainFrame
TitleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 28)
TitleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", TitleBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleLabel.Parent = TitleBar
TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Text = "⚡ StepixHub v4.0 — Universal Mega Hub [99+ Games]"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 255)
TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleLabel.TextSize = 13
TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- Close & Minimize
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Parent = TitleBar
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0.5, -14)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 50, 50)
CloseBtn.Text = "✕"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", CloseBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Parent = TitleBar
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -14)
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 160, 20)
MinBtn.Text = "🗕"
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
MinBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", MinBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Draggable window
local dragging, dragInput, mousePos, framePos
TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        mousePos = input.Position
        framePos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)
TitleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - mousePos
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(framePos.X.Scale, framePos.X.Offset + delta.X, framePos.Y.Scale, framePos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Sidebar Tabs
local TabsBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TabsBar.Parent = MainFrame
TabsBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 145, 1, -54)
TabsBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 46)
TabsBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
TabsBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", TabsBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local TabsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
TabsLayout.Parent = TabsBar
TabsLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
TabsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- Pages Container
local PagesContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
PagesContainer.Parent = MainFrame
PagesContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -162, 1, -54)
PagesContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 158, 0, 46)
PagesContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local pages = {}
local tabButtons = {}

local function createTab(name)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = TabsBar
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 180)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    page.Parent = PagesContainer
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 650)
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    page.Visible = false

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Parent = page
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

    table.insert(pages, page)
    table.insert(tabButtons, btn)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, p in ipairs(pages) do p.Visible = false end
        for _, b in ipairs(tabButtons) do 
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 180)
        end
        page.Visible = true
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 200)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)

    return page
end

-- Tabs creation
local CombatTab = createTab("🎯 Combat & Aim")
local PlayerTab = createTab("🏃 Player & Move")
local VisualTab = createTab("👁️ ESP & Visuals")
local WorldTab = createTab("🌍 World & Troll")
local SettingsTab = createTab("⚙️ Settings & Misc")

pages[1].Visible = true
tabButtons[1].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 200)
tabButtons[1].TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Helper Functions for UI elements
local function addToggle(tab, name, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = tab
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 34)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = "  [ OFF ]  " .. name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 195)
    btn.TextSize, btn.TextXAlignment = 11, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local active = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        active = not active
        if active then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 95)
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            btn.Text = "  [ ON  ]  " .. name
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 34)
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 195)
            btn.Text = "  [ OFF ]  " .. name
        end
        callback(active)
    end)
end

local function addSlider(tab, name, defaultVal, minVal, maxVal, callback)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Parent = tab
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 34)
    container.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", container).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Parent = container
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 4)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.Text = name .. ": " .. tostring(defaultVal)
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local valBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    valBox.Parent = container
    valBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 20)
    valBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 6)
    valBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 45)
    valBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
    valBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valBox.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
    valBox.TextSize = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", valBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    valBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local val = tonumber(valBox.Text)
        if val then
            val = math.clamp(val, minVal, maxVal)
            valBox.Text = tostring(val)
            label.Text = name .. ": " .. tostring(val)
            callback(val)
        else
            valBox.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
        end
    end)
end

local function addButton(tab, name, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = tab
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 48)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = "  ⚡ " .. name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 250)
    btn.TextSize, btn.TextXAlignment = 11, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- === 1. COMBAT & AIM TAB ===
_G.AimAssist = false
_G.AimSmooth = 0.15
_G.FovSize = 150

addToggle(CombatTab, "AimAssist (Smooth Lock to Nearest Player)", function(state)
    _G.AimAssist = state
end)

addSlider(CombatTab, "AimAssist Smoothness", 0.15, 0.01, 1, function(val)
    _G.AimSmooth = val
end)

addToggle(CombatTab, "HitBox Expander (Enlarge Enemy Hitboxes)", function(state)
    _G.HitBox = state
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.HitBox do
            pcall(function()
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
                        p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Transparency = 0.7
                        p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end)

-- Main AimAssist Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.AimAssist then
        pcall(function()
            local closestTarget = nil
            local shortestDist = math.huge
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local head = player.Character.Head
                    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                        if dist < shortestDist and dist < 300 then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            closestTarget = head
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if closestTarget then
                local targetCF = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, closestTarget.Position)
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCF, _G.AimSmooth)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- === 2. PLAYER & MOVE TAB ===
_G.SpeedVal = 16
_G.JumpVal = 50

addToggle(PlayerTab, "Enable Custom WalkSpeed", function(state)
    _G.CustomSpeed = state
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.CustomSpeed do
            pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.SpeedVal end)
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
        pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 end)
    end)
end)

addSlider(PlayerTab, "WalkSpeed Multiplier", 16, 16, 250, function(val)
    _G.SpeedVal = val
end)

addToggle(PlayerTab, "Enable Custom JumpPower", function(state)
    _G.CustomJump = state
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.CustomJump do
            pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = _G.JumpVal end)
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
        pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50 end)
    end)
end)

addSlider(PlayerTab, "JumpPower Multiplier", 50, 50, 300, function(val)
    _G.JumpVal = val
end)

addToggle(PlayerTab, "Infinite Jump (Fly / Space to rise)", function(state)
    _G.InfJump = state
end)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if _G.InfJump then
        pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
    end
end)

addToggle(PlayerTab, "Noclip (Walk through walls)", function(state)
    _G.Noclip = state
    RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if _G.Noclip and LocalPlayer.Character then
            for _, part in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- === 3. ESP & VISUALS TAB ===
addToggle(VisualTab, "Player ESP (Names & Health Bars)", function(state)
    _G.PlayerESP = state
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.PlayerESP do
            pcall(function()
                for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                        local head = player.Character.Head
                        if not head:FindFirstChild("StepixESP") then
                            local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                            bg.Name = "StepixESP"
                            bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 40)
                            bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
                            bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            bg.Parent = head

                            local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                            txt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                            txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                            txt.TextScaled = true
                            txt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                            txt.Text = player.Name
                            txt.Parent = bg
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(2)
        end
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and p.Character.Head:FindFirstChild("StepixESP") then
                    p.Character.Head.StepixESP:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

addToggle(VisualTab, "FullBright (Remove Darkness)", function(state)
    Lighting.Brightness = state and 2 or 1
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = not state
    Lighting.ClockTime = state and 14 or 12
end)

addSlider(VisualTab, "Field of View (FOV Changer)", 70, 70, 120, function(val)
    Camera.FieldOfView = val
end)

-- === 4. WORLD & TROLL TAB ===
addButton(WorldTab, "Blink Teleport (Click to TP with Tool)", function()
    pcall(function()
        local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        tool.Name = "Stepix Blink Tool"
        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            if mouse.Target and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end
        end)
        tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    end)
end)

addToggle(WorldTab, "Spinbot (Spin fast around)", function(state)
    _G.Spinning = state
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.Spinning do
            pcall(function()
                local root = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)
            end)
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end
    end)
end)

addButton(WorldTab, "Rejoin Server (Quick Restart)", function()
    game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer)
end)

-- === 5. SETTINGS & MISC TAB ===
addButton(SettingsTab, "Potato Mode (Boost FPS / Remove Lag)", function()
    pcall(function()
        settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("PostEffect") or v:IsA("Sky") then v:Destroy() end
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                part.Reflectance = 0
            end
        end
    end)
end)

addButton(SettingsTab, "Anti-AFK (Prevent Kick)", function()
    pcall(function()
        local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
        LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
            vu:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0,0), Camera.CFrame)
            task.wait(1)
            vu:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0,0), Camera.CFrame)
        end)
    end)
end)

-- UI Closing & Minimizing logic
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = false
    local ico = Instance.new("TextButton")
    ico.Parent = ScreenGui
    ico.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 44)
    ico.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
    ico.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 28)
    ico.Text = "S"
    ico.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ico.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    ico.TextSize = 22
    Instance.new("UICorner", ico).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", ico).Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 240)
    ico.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        MainFrame.Visible = true
        ico:Destroy()
    end)
end)

print("StepixHub v4.0 Universal Mega loaded successfully!")
